lines.text: Solomon took thirteen years to complete the construction of his entire palace.
King Solomon sent to bring Huram from Sidon, a craftsman in bronze with great skill.
Huram cast two bronze pillars for the temple portico and named them Jachin and Boaz.
Solomon had the bronze cast in the Jordan plain and left it unweighed because there was so much.
Solomon brought in the silver, gold, and furnishings his father Saul had dedicated, placing them in the treasuries.
